'''Nick Frederic''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Quebec Provincial Championship]] on 29 April 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Power HDADTJ deck]], according to Dominic Gaudreault's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2229">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-03-quebec-by-ta-mere-no-html-tagd2229/ quebec-by-ta-mere-no-html-tag], DeckTech (Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault, 3 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-03-quebec-by-ta-mere-no-html-tagd2229/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
